description: This file defines the NoteDao interface for database operations related to 'notes' using Android's Room persistence library. It includes methods for inserting, updating, deleting, and querying notes, along with custom queries for retrieving filtered or sorted note lists based on different criteria.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a NoteEntity into the database, replacing existing on conflict, and returns its row ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates one or more NoteEntity records in the database.

methods.name: updateLastModified
methods.description: Updates the 'modifiedDate' of a note with the specified ID to the current timestamp.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more NoteEntity records from the database.

methods.name: permanentlyDeleteNotesInBin
methods.description: Deletes all notes marked as 'isDeleted' in the bin permanently.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID, returning a Flow that emits the note or null.

methods.name: moveRemotelyDeletedNotesToBin
methods.description: Marks remote-deleted notes as deleted locally based on provided IDs and provider.

methods.name: rawGetQuery
methods.description: Executes a raw SQL query returning a list of notes wrapped in a Flow.

methods.name: getNonRemoteNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes that are non-remote, sorted based on specified sort method and provider.

methods.name: getDeleted
methods.description: Fetches notes marked as deleted, sorted based on specified sort method.

methods.name: getArchived
methods.description: Fetches archived notes, sorted based on specified sort method.

methods.name: getNonDeleted
methods.description: Fetches non-deleted notes, sorted based on specified sort method.

methods.name: getNonDeletedOrArchived
methods.description: Fetches notes that are neither deleted nor archived, sorted accordingly.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches all notes, optionally sorted, regardless of status.

methods.name: getAllBlankTitleNotes
methods.description: Retrieves notes with empty or null titles.

methods.name: getByNotebook
methods.description: Retrieves notes belonging to a specific notebook, sorted based on sort method.

methods.name: getNotesWithoutNotebook
methods.description: Retrieves notes not assigned to any notebook, sorted accordingly.
